_comment: Scale-only run (100% original-style) with Granite served by vLLM on the cluster. Secrets and hosts come from environment variables. seed, sources, max_schema_kb and test_ratio are CONFIRMED from the v2 manifests. temperature 0.7, max_tokens 4096 and top_p 0.95 are OUR PROVISIONAL values: the original ones could not be recovered (docs/original_generation_settings.md). Do not run without approval.
_provenance: CONFIRMED from the published v2 manifests: sources schemas+jsb_schemas, max_schema_kb 10, seed 0, test_ratio 0.15 (these define the original training pool, so keep them). The ORIGINAL builder was openai/gpt-oss-120b; Granite is a different model. This run keeps the original generation logic, prompts, thresholds and schema pool but CHANGES the original one-example-per-schema policy (see docs/schema_reuse.md). Temperature/max tokens above are our provisional values, not the original ones.

reuse._comment: Controlled schema reuse (differs from the original one-example-per-schema policy). Each attempt mints an independent reference with the unchanged standard prompt; a reference equal to a published or earlier new one for that schema is rejected. Cap = max new references per schema (each feeds up to 3 tasks). A schema failing max_failures_per_schema attempts in a row sits out suspend_passes passes (max_suspensions times), then is retired for the run; the target is still pursued with other schemas. sampling_seed_param, e.g. "seed", would pass a per-attempt integer to the provider; left null because it is not verified for the Granite endpoint. pool_source published_train: the pool is the set of schemas of the published TRAINING rows (ids, content and hashes as published; see docs/schema_reuse.md), minus schemas that overlap the published test set by id or content hash, minus schemas larger than anchor_max_schema_kb (an explicit experimental restriction, NOT a claim about how the Hugging Face snapshot was generated). The top-level sources/seed/split are kept for provenance and validation but do not define the pool in this mode.
